svg.title: Repairing AGV paths after assignment
svg.desc: EnsureAgvMovePathsClear replays the DAG in topological order; if an AGV reposition is blocked only by another AGV's body, it gates the move on that AGV's next departure.
svg.metadata: ["RunAgvPathRepairPass() replays the DAG in topological order with exact AGV occupancy. At index k it reaches the AgvMove that sends A from W25 to W8.", "Check 1: is A's path feasible when only A itself is ignored? No: the path down past W13 is blocked, so TryClearBlockedAgvMove() continues.", "Check 2: ignoring every other AGV the path is clear, so the obstacle is an AGV, not a tray or a disabled node.", "Check 3: try each other AGV X and ignore only {A, X}. With X = B the path clears: B, parked on W13, is the blocker.", "Check 4: FindAgvDepartureFromNode(B, W13) looks after index k for the event in which B leaves W13: B's AgvMove W13 -> P15.", "Check 5: AddDependency(departure, A's move), unless that would form a cycle. A now waits until B has left W13.", "The pass returns true (one edge added) and EnsureAgvMovePathsClear starts a fresh replay. It stops when a full replay adds nothing, on an error, or after 256 passes."]
